notes: kb/Work PB443 - RE-RECORDED, verdict unchanged, on a repaired premise. SR9's screens were right; WHICH level-88 they were asked about was not. CheckConditionNameSide selected `conds.FirstOrDefault(c => IsWithin(c.Parent, table)) ?? conds[0]` - a BASE-WORD lookup with the tie broken by DECLARATION ORDER - so the OF/IN qualifier that the condition BINDER honours was ignored by the SCREEN and the two disagreed about which key the WHEN referenced. ISO 8.4.2.2 Format 2 decides that question and it is now decided in the ONE place, ConditionBinder.ConditionOf, which gained a one-report-per-reference guard so the screen and the later bind cannot both report the same ambiguity. A reference whose qualifiers single out no declaration is now reported by SR9's own sink rather than silently resolved to a neighbour.
